evals.name: mixed-commits
evals.prompt: Generate changelog from these commits: abc1234 feat: add user search, def5678 fix: resolve null pointer on login, ghi9012 chore: update dependencies

assertions.name: file-exists
assertions.description: CHANGELOG.md exists in the output directory

assertions.name: all_sections_present
assertions.description: Output CHANGELOG.md contains all four sections: Breaking Changes, New Features, Bug Fixes, and Other

assertions.name: entries-use-hash-format
assertions.description: Each commit entry starts with a backtick-wrapped short hash followed by a colon — e.g., '`abc1234`: subject'

evals.name: fixes-only
evals.prompt: Generate changelog: fix: resolve memory leak in worker, fix: handle empty response from API, fix: correct date formatting in reports

assertions.name: file-exists
assertions.description: CHANGELOG.md exists in the output directory

assertions.name: entries-use-hash-format
assertions.description: Each commit entry starts with a backtick-wrapped short hash — e.g., '`abc1234`: subject'
